name: Wheel Spin
author: WolfyMaster LLC
description: A prize wheel for your scene. Keep as many entries as you like in its settings or add them from workflows, spin it from a workflow, button or stream deck, and watch it land on a winner. Picked entries can stay on the wheel or come off it.

settings.label: Entries on the wheel
settings.description: Everything on the wheel. Add the same entry twice to give it a better chance. Adding to or removing from the wheel changes this list too.

settings.label: Take the winner off the wheel
settings.description: On: whatever the wheel lands on comes off it, so it can't win twice. Off: it stays on for the next spin.

settings.label: Seconds to spin
settings.description: How long the wheel spins before it lands, unless a spin says otherwise.

settings.label: Say the winner in chat
settings.description: Your bot tells chat what the wheel landed on.

actions.name: Add to the Wheel
actions.description: Puts an entry on the wheel. Put each entry on its own line to add several at once. The same entry can go on more than once, for a bigger chance to win.

actions.name: Remove from the Wheel
actions.description: Takes an entry off the wheel. Capital letters don't matter.

schema.label: Remove every copy
schema.description: Off takes off one copy of an entry that's on the wheel more than once.

fields.description: Entries taken off; 0 when it wasn't on the wheel.

actions.name: Clear the Wheel
actions.description: Takes every entry off the wheel.

actions.name: Spin the Wheel
actions.description: Spins the wheel and picks a winner. The Wheel landed trigger fires when it stops. Does nothing while the wheel is still spinning or has nothing on it.

schema.label: Seconds
schema.description: Leave empty to use the module's setting.

fields.description: False when the wheel was busy or empty.
What the wheel will land on. It's picked now, but shown only when the wheel stops.
Entries on the wheel after this spin.

triggers.name: Wheel landed
triggers.description: Fires when the wheel stops spinning, with what it landed on.

fields.description: Whether it was taken off the wheel.

deadlines.description: Announces the winner once the wheel has stopped on screen.

widgets.name: Wheel Spin
widgets.description: The wheel with every entry on it. It spins when the wheel is spun, then shows the winner big in the middle.

settingsSchema.label: Title
settingsSchema.description: Shown above the wheel. Leave empty for none.

settingsSchema.label: Only show while spinning
settingsSchema.description: Hide the wheel until it spins, and again after the winner is shown.

settingsSchema.label: Seconds to show the winner
settingsSchema.description: 0 keeps the winner up until the next spin.
